theme_and_archetype.description: Inspired by Duolingo and Khan Academy Kids, focusing on a dark mode MVP with neon blue accents. Transmits technology, accessibility, and trust through deep navy backgrounds, vibrant royal blue, and soft neon cyan highlights.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Mobile-first, generous spacing for touch targets, highly rounded corners.

navigation.mobile: Fixed bottom navigation bar, h-16, backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#1E293B]/90 border-t border-slate-700
navigation.desktop: Fixed left sidebar, w-64, bg-[#1E293B] border-r border-slate-700

buttons.primary_3d: bg-blue-500 text-white font-bold rounded-xl border-b-4 border-blue-700 hover:bg-blue-400 hover:border-blue-600 active:border-b-0 active:translate-y-1 transition-all
buttons.neon_glow: bg-cyan-500 text-slate-900 font-bold rounded-xl shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,229,255,0.5)] hover:shadow-[0_0_25px_rgba(0,229,255,0.7)] transition-all
buttons.secondary_3d: bg-slate-700 text-white font-bold rounded-xl border-b-4 border-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-600 active:border-b-0 active:translate-y-1 transition-all

cards.default: bg-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-6 border border-slate-700 shadow-lg
cards.interactive: bg-slate-800 rounded-2xl p-6 border-2 border-transparent hover:border-blue-500 hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all cursor-pointer shadow-lg

components.progress_bar: h-4 bg-slate-700 rounded-full overflow-hidden, inner fill: bg-gradient-to-r from-blue-500 to-cyan-400 rounded-full transition-all duration-500
components.inputs: bg-slate-900 border-2 border-slate-700 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-white focus:border-cyan-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-cyan-500 transition-all

animations.feedback: Use Framer Motion for bouncy, gamified feedback. e.g., correct answers scale up briefly (scale: 1.05) and glow green.
animations.page_transition: Fade in and slight slide up (y: 20 to 0) for new pages/lessons.
animations.streak_flame: Pulse and slight rotation animation for the streak flame icon.

images.description: 3D level map background for the learning journey
3D cute robot avatar for user profile
3D floating blue crystal used as premium currency or high reward
3D gold coin for standard xp/currency rewards
3D styled hand doing a sign language gesture, useful for lesson cards or dictionary

icons.styling: strokeWidth={2.5} to match the chunky, friendly gamified aesthetic.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all buttons use the 'primary_3d' or 'secondary_3d' style classes for the Duolingo-like press effect.
Implement a fixed side navigation for desktop (`lg:w-64` hidden on mobile) and a bottom navigation bar for mobile (`lg:hidden`).
The Home page should feature a gamified 'Path' (timeline) showing levels/phases. Use the 'hero_or_learning_path_background' as the section background if suitable.
Incorporate gamification elements in the header/top-bar: User Level, XP Bar, Coins, and Daily Streak.
All interactive elements MUST have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='start-lesson-button'`).
Use framer-motion to add bouncy entrance animations to cards and modal popups.
Use Nunito font globally for a friendly, approachable vibe.
Do not implement a light/dark toggle. The app is strictly dark mode (Dark/Neon Blue) for this MVP.
